subject: I found a secret time hack in SoulPlan
preview_text: Stop spending 20 minutes planning dates. This one feature does it in 2. You're welcome.
body_paragraphs: Look, I'm not going to pretend I haven't wasted entire evenings scrolling for restaurant menus, checking availability, and trying to remember if we already did that escape room. It's a nightmare. But last week, I stumbled on something in SoulPlan that made me feel like an idiot for not using it sooner.

Here's the truth: most couples I talk to spend at least 20 minutes hunting for a decent date idea. Twenty minutes you could spend actually hanging out. I was one of them. Then I let the app's AI do the heavy lifting. I told it our mood, budget, and how much time we had. Two minutes later, I had three solid options, including a local jazz bar I'd never noticed.

That's the trick. The AI date generator doesn't just throw random ideas at you. It pulls from your shared wishlist, your past dates, and local hotspots. It's like having a personal assistant who knows your relationship and your city. No more tab-hopping, no more 'what do you want to do?' conversations that end in a shrug.

Open SoulPlan right now, tap 'Generate Date,' and set it to 'Quick & Easy.' See what pops up in under two minutes. I dare you to go back to the old way. P.S. If you've been ignoring the 'Surprise Date' feature, that's the real gold. One click, and your partner gets a mystery plan texted to them. You'll look like a hero without lifting a finger.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and generate a date now
